description: Prompt for testing the changes against the acceptance criteria locally, the way the test plan says, failures master has too failing none (the grouped and v2 engines, ASS-114)

is-approved.description: true when every acceptance criterion passed; false sends the ticket back to build

did-not-finish.description: true when the testing itself did not complete within the turn (a suite cut short, say), so the verdict is no judgement of the change: the v2 engines re-run Test instead of sending the ticket back to build. Give it on every verdict, false when the testing did finish

summary.description: One line: what passed, or what failed
